description:
## Why

The PKITS baseline (PKIX-7nsf.6) surfaced 13 `StricterThanWild` chains where pkix-path reports `signature invalid at chain index N` but OpenSSL accepts. All are PKITS §4.4 (Separate Cert/CRL Keys) and §4.14 (Indirect CRL / cRLIssuer) tests, plus §4.5 self-issued-rollover tests. The cause is documented in the bd memory `pkits-certpath-is-bundle-not-signature-chain`:

> PKITS vectors.json `CertPath` is intended as a bundle for path builders, not a pre-ordered signature chain. For most tests CertPath happens to also be the signature chain. For §4.4, §4.14, and some §4.5 tests, CertPath includes a non-signing cert at a position that breaks pkix-path's positional walk.

This is not a pkix-path bug. The harness's PKITS loader (`src/corpus/pkits.rs`) passes `CertPath` through verbatim; the fix is to use path-building before invoking pkix-path.

## What

Integrate `pkix-path-builder` into the harness PKITS loader:

1. Where the loader currently passes `CertPath` verbatim, instead call `pkix_path_builder::build_path(bundle, leaf, trust_anchors)` to assemble a properly-ordered signature chain. The bundle includes the CRL-signing cert; the path builder picks the actual signature chain by walking AKI → SKI, dropping the CRL-signing cert from the path (it would remain in a bundle if/when revocation lands in the harness).
2. The resulting Chain is then passed to pkix-path's positional walker.

`pkix-path-builder` already exists at `pkix-path-builder/` in the workspace (currently 0.3.0), so this is integration work, not new crate development.

## Acceptance

- [ ] PKITS baseline re-run shows 0 `StricterThanWild` chains with reason `signature invalid at chain index N`.
- [ ] No regressions: `Agreement` count goes UP, no other class moves except `StricterThanWild` going DOWN.
- [ ] Documentation update: `pkix-difftest/baseline-pkits.md` and `baseline-pkits-analysis.md` updated to remove the "harness limitation" notes for the 13 affected chains.

## Filed as

Follow-up to PKIX-7nsf.6. With AGENTS.md's "path building out of scope for v0.1" line removed (PKIX-agp7.1), this becomes integration work using the existing pkix-path-builder crate rather than a tactical AKI/SKI walk in the harness or a from-scratch path-builder bootstrap.
title: diff harness: PKITS CertPath includes non-signing certs (path-building integration)
